newsitem.title: NEPAL: Tiger kills 35 children in Nepal.
newsitem.headline: Tiger kills 35 children in Nepal.

text.p: Villagers in western Nepal's Baitadi district have been terrorised by a man-eating tiger that has killed 35 children in recent days, news reports said on Friday.
The state-owned RSS news agency said the wild cat in Baitadi has been attacking people at "slightest chance" in the evenings. It did not say when the attacks began.
"People...do not dare to venture out from their houses due to the terror unleashed by the man-eater tiger," RSS quoted Chandra Mohan Tiwari, a resident in Kumaun village in west Nepal, as saying.
Chief District Officer Sthaneshwar Devkota told the RSS news agency that the local administration had approved the shooting of the tiger.
Tigers are protected by law in Nepal.
